records.source: 遠国の少女が使用した槍を{j}模した太刀。少女の言葉は{j}届かず同胞の心は闇に染まる。
records.previous: A Long Sword{j}modeled after the spear used by a girl from a distant land. The girl's words did not{j}reach, and her brethren's hearts were stained in darkness.
records.target: Long Sword modeled after a girl's spear.{j}Her words went unheard; her kin's hearts{j}were stained by darkness.

records.source: 緑の装飾が施された黒い大剣。{j}儀礼用であったものを鍛え、{j}至高の逸品へと昇華した。
records.previous: A black Great Sword adorned with green ornamentation.{j}Forged from what was once a ceremonial blade,{j}it has been refined into a supreme masterpiece.
records.target: Black Great Sword with green ornament.{j}Forged from a ceremonial blade into{j}a supreme masterpiece.

records.source: 緑の装飾が施された黒い狩猟{j}笛。儀礼用であったものを鍛{j}え、至高の逸品へと昇華した。

records.source: 古来より伝わる遠国の賢者の{j}伝承を元に作成された片手剣。{j}持ち主に風の力を宿すという。
records.previous: A Sword & Shield forged from the{j}legend of a sage from a distant land, handed down since ancient times.{j}It is said to imbue its wielder with the power of wind.
records.target: Sword & Shield from a sage's legend.{j}Passed down through the ages, it is said{j}to grant its wielder wind power.
